description:
Goal
Prove the product path removes churn and preserves behavior on fixtures2/00181_enum_reduce_operator_ref.fz.

Required proof
- Run current no-dump baseline and product-path no-dump telemetry with --log-telemetry.
- Use targeted dumps for types, activations, backend, and product shape inspection. Avoid fnir unless intentionally testing native because fnir pulls native lowering.
- Compare product-path telemetry against the plan baseline: current branch no-dump interp is 378 job fires, 174 unique jobs; old ../survey.html baseline was 497 job fires with 86 SealSemanticClosure jobs total.
- Product path must show SealSemanticClosure=0, DeriveTransportPlan=0, MaterializeRoot=0, DeriveAbiReady=0, DeriveEmissionReady=0, follow_ups=0, root_scans=0.
- Product path must preserve main/0[] => {int, int}, two Enum.reduce callsites returning int, direct Kernel.+/2 arity-2 callable facts, no boundary ids, and integer tuple return lanes.

Signal
A checked-in test or telemetry post-processing assertion proves reduced churn and forbidden-job absence for the product path.

Removal target
Identify any temporary compatibility scaffolding that must be deleted in the next ticket. If new scaffolding cannot be removed immediately, create and link a cleanup ticket before closing this one.

Verification
cargo run --quiet --bin fz2 -- --log-telemetry /tmp/fz00181_pull.jsonl interp fixtures2/00181_enum_reduce_operator_ref.fz; targeted dump command from ../pull-based.html; focused regression tests.
title: Pull path: prove fixture 00181 with telemetry and dumps
